livelinechart.basic: Live stream with pause and stop
livelinechart.contract: Point time is Unix seconds. Latest value is a separate required prop. Defaults: 30-second window, 5 ticks, leading offset 0, lerpSpeed 0.08 and height 300px. paused freezes scrolling while latest-value interpolation and Y-range changes continue. Invalid window/ticks/speed revert to defaults. The demo source updates every second, supports stopping and cleans up on unmount; the component does not open a WebSocket.
livelinechart.keyboard: Tab enters once; arrows, Home and End inspect data, Escape or blur clears the tooltip. Reduced motion disables decorative loops. ChartLegend layout/overflow are API options; inline/collapse fits multiple entries and folds overflow.
livelinechart.compatibility: Import shared tooltip and legend from chart-core. Existing chart/Recharts and chart-primitives APIs remain available with their own contracts.
